hook: "Policy not found." Was it the agent, the retrieval, or the data?
body:
A claims request hits the gateway, which mints a correlation ID. The header carries it to the claims agent, which logs it with the model ID.

Under the same ID, retrieval queries the vector DB and gets zero results; the agent logs it and answers "Policy not found". Every hop exports its spans, so one ID tells the whole story.

The takeaway: one ID across every hop turns guesswork into a trace. Observability sits in the CCAR-P security and compliance domain.
